Name: Underling
Notes: Underground shennanigans. Cannot attack while underground. Cannot attack enemies underground or things directly on top of it. Cannot be targeted I think either, so defense underground is irrelevant

Name: Engineer
Notes: Says it can't attack after move, but it can reprogram after move. Emp, healing

Name: Battery
Notes: Two actions, no attack after move

Name: Cyber Underling
Notes: Created via assimilation, underground shennanigans. See notes on primary underling

Name: Assimilator
Notes: Says it can't attack after move, but it can assimilate after move. UV, healing

Name: Skimmer
Notes: Can target things directly on top of it while underwater (and range of 2 away) so I say range = 0-2
